meta.name: memory-index-lint
meta.description: Validate discoverability invariants of memory `index.md` and `archive/superseded-decisions.archive.md`. Tool-agnostic L3 prompt + capability-dependent L4 script. Detects table corruption, dangling/orphan supersession pointers, frontmatter inconsistencies, missing affordance signals.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查记忆索引与归档文档的结构一致性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果维护项目记忆系统并确保文档链接正确
copy.tagline_en: Validate structure of memory index and archive documents
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain project memory and need correct document links

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会自动检查记忆索引和存档文件，确保表格格式正确、链接完整、元数据一致，并生成违规报告。
howto.when: 在提交代码前、合并后或手动编辑记忆文件时触发检查。

say.text: 请检查我的记忆索引是否完整。
say.note: Claude会运行完整检查并报告问题。

say.text: 验证一下存档文件中的决策记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically validates the memory index and archive files, checking table column consistency, supersession pointers, frontmatter correctness, and producing a lint report.
howto.when_en: The check triggers before commits, after merges, or after manual edits to memory files.

say_en.text: Check my memory index for issues.
